ui_bugs.issue: Bottom items of Lainnya menu (e.g. mobile-more-returns at y=783 h=61) overlap the fixed tab bar (top=789) when the list is long. Normal taps still work for a human user, but any auto-scroll alignment that places the button center within the tabbar strip (y>789) causes the tap to hit the tab bar instead. In testing we needed an extra window.scrollBy(0,120) after scrollIntoView to clear the overlap. Suggest adding bottom padding to the scroll container equal to tab bar height (e.g. padding-bottom: 72px on main) so the last items are always above the tab bar.

action_items: (Minor UX) Add bottom padding/safe-area to the Lainnya scroll container so the last menu items (e.g. mobile-more-special, mobile-more-returns on short viewports) are not partially covered by the fixed tab bar.

Positive: CreateSpecialOrderForm reused for mobile — od-refs step with od-ref-camera-input (capture=environment) is well-wired; thumbnails + remove buttons tested OK.

Observation: m-return-evidence hidden for status 'refund_settled' is correct by spec, but may want a muted 'Retur sudah diselesaikan — bukti tertutup' note so users understand why camera button disappears in detail.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Mobile Lainnya menu scroll overlap: when testing mobile-more-* buttons via Playwright, always do: scroll_into_view_if_needed() + window.scrollBy(0, 120) BEFORE click, otherwise the click lands on the fixed tab bar (e.g. Keranjang) and misroutes you. CreateReturnForm embedded is the same desktop component — return-order-select is a native select (page.select_option works). CreateSpecialOrderForm is wrapped in modal that captures Escape to close. For md@ regression use testid prefix 'm-md-tab-*' (NOT 'mobile-tab-btn-*'). API /api/sales/my-rank requires MONGO_URL+DB_NAME in env for conftest; use `set -a && . ./.env && set +a && python -m pytest tests/test_sales_my_rank.py -n0` from /app/backend.
rca of the issue: N/A — no blocking issues. One cosmetic concern: fixed .m-tabbar overlays the bottom of the Lainnya scroll content on short viewports (~390x844 with 2 open groups). Mitigation: add safe bottom padding (e.g. padding-bottom: calc(72px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom))) to the Lainnya main container, or to the last section's margin-bottom.
